title: identity-firewall -- trust tags, the staged identity ladder's records, trifecta booleans, redaction notes, and the export bundle
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/identity-firewall.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = oneOf the contract's fenced record shapes: the two-axis identity record (B.2), the frame block (B.3), the tool-profile trifecta annex (B-Annex-1), and the hc export bundle (B.7). Enums live in $defs: trust_channel (the enum this contract owns -- B.3 stamping rule), trust_tag (control|data), ladder_stage, trifecta booleans (ALL THREE recomputed as folds at every ingress, s6-05; declared trifecta{} is ADVISORY, s6-03), waiver_policy, the always-privileged type set (B.9), and the redaction-note shape (B.5 markers land in wire.md 2.1's reserved redactions[] column). Reader liberality (B.0.1): unknown envelope fields, unknown trust_tag values, and unknown waiver_policy names MUST be ignored, not errored on; an absent sig means unsigned (validity is the stage ratchet's, B.6.3); an absent trust_tag MUST default to data -- fail-closed on security-relevant defaults, fail-open (ignore) on forward-compatibility ones. No smuggled 10th contract: the trust_channel enum, the trifecta annex, and the waiver-policy set version with THIS contract's semver (B.11).

trust_channel.$comment: B.3 stamping rule -- the provenance enum this contract owns (02's percept.trust reads it): operator-console/operator-key channel -> operator (=> trust_tag control); ACL-privileged type + ACL-verified sender -> receipted; the cell's own tool result -> tool; anything else -> external. Non-suppliable, transport-ASSIGNED like seq/ts; absent => external (fail-closed). control maps to operator only; data covers {receipted, tool, external}

trust_tag.$comment: B.3 frame-level binary: control iff the channel is the operator directive channel; data otherwise. Default (unknown/absent) = data (fail-closed, B.0.1). A data block MUST NOT be promotable to control by its own content -- assignment, not detection (L-FIREWALL)

ladder_stage.$comment: B.1/B.6.5 -- current_stage() is a FOLD over command{kind:stage_bump} records (no lie-able field); the ratchet law (B.6.3): once a stage's trigger fires, lower-stage validation is no longer SUFFICIENT for the types it protects (a stripped signature is refused/downgrade, never demoted to Stage-0 validity). B.2's authority.stage uses the integer coarsening 0|1|2|3. Stage 3 (federated agent identity) is REFUSED until a ratified standard clears the trigger

identity_record.$comment: B.2 -- the two-axis identity record, carried in the cell's nucleus instance block; every field is a FOLD over spawn/grant/command records or an operator import -- NONE is a cell-suppliable envelope field (membrane.py:13's sender-trusting origin is repealed)

claim_id.$comment: spiffe://<trust-domain>/<claim-path> naming shape (Stage-2, E.14) -- forward-compatible, zero SPIRE dependency

stage.$comment: the fabric's CURRENT triggered stage (ratchet, B.6.3)

may_direct.$comment: only the operator principal is ever true

signed_by.$comment: set by verify(), never by the cell

capability.$comment: the attenuation law (Stage 2): a child's authority is a subset of the parent's, budget carved, not minted -- Biscuit offline-attenuation semantics, zero crypto dependency; set-inclusion checked at the spawn gate (SEC-4/CELL-7)

egress_allow.$comment: subset of parent.egress_allow; empty = deny-all (v2 sec 11)

grant_ref.$comment: substrate grant id; short-lived; null at H0-generic

budget_usd.$comment: carved from parent escrow, never minted

frame_block.$comment: B.3 -- the unit of context assembly (assembly algorithm frame_v1, deterministic, versioned). The trust_tag and provenance.channel are transport-ASSIGNED envelope metadata -- like seq and ts -- NEVER a body convention and NEVER sender-suppliable (the non-suppliability rule). At most one control directive per frame; data blocks are structurally fenced; the v1 as_data() string wrap is kept only as a redundant render

trust_floor.$comment: 02's terminal trust tag; diversity/entailment reads this; a factual register entry is auditable-to-terminal or it does not enter as factual (B.3 step 4)

fenced.$comment: data blocks are rendered inside an un-spoofable structural fence; control blocks render in a region the data fence cannot reach

trifecta.$comment: B.4 -- the lethal-trifecta gate (Meta's Rule of Two, mechanical): three booleans computed structurally, never by a classifier. All three true at spawn => REFUSE to instantiate (refused/trifecta) unless an operator waiver applies. ALL THREE booleans are FOLDS re-evaluated at every ingress (s6-05; a log query, never a monitor): the act gate's step 1h refuses (reason:trifecta) whenever the POST-INGRESS fold shows all three true (holds-all-three), regardless of which channel set the third. Declared trifecta{} is ADVISORY (s6-03): the gate RECOMPUTES from exfil_channel + egress_allow + role holdings + the folds, and REFUSES admission when declared < recomputed. The exfil rule: external_comms := egress-allowlist breadth OR cell-composed destination, NEVER method (a read-only GET can exfiltrate -- EchoLeak)

private_data.$comment: FOLD (s6-05): standing_access JOIN fold(received handoff/submission/pollination from other claim_ids) JOIN (operator-memory grant present) -- role.md's standing_access (LB4) is the declared leg

untrusted_content.$comment: FOLD over the cell's exec-ok receipts (acquired on the first world-content fetch, not static). PROVENANCE-TAINT LAW (R8): output of an untrusted_content=true cell is adversarial-EQUIVALENT -- class-3 or REFUSED

external_comms.$comment: FOLD: profile JOIN fold(egress grants acquired) -- can the role send bytes to an unpinned destination (the exfil rule above)

waiver_policy.$comment: B.4 waiver precedence (operator forces external_comms -> H3 = operator-always, then picks a policy): scoped-act (default; ephemeral class-3 sandbox + one-endpoint egress + signed operator grant -- the trifecta broken by construction), shed-egress, quarantine-and-gate (every act held for operator co-sign, H3). Unknown waiver_policy names are ignored by readers (B.0.1)

tool_profile_trifecta_annex.$comment: B-Annex-1 -- the tool-profile trifecta annex: format owned by seat 06 (act.md sec 10.2, where credential_carrier additionally names none), boolean semantics by seat 10 (this contract), pricing by seat 07. Change credential_carrier/exfil_channel/egress_allow and the booleans recompute -- that is the derivation rule. The declared trifecta{} here is ADVISORY (s6-03): B.4's gate recomputes and an under-declaring profile fails admission

credential_carrier.$comment: drives redaction (B.5) + provenance scrub (06-T3); act.md 10.2's format-owner enum adds none

redaction_note.$comment: B.5 -- the redaction pass runs BEFORE canonicalization and append (the chain never witnesses a secret; verify() never needs a secret); each hit replaced with a marker; the redactor writes its markers into the wire redactions[] envelope column, which IS inside the canonical leaf (wire.md 2.1 shape mirrored here: {field, kind, n}) -- redactor-assigned, non-suppliable, lands as a wire MINOR with secrets.py. Nucleus-side, the ledger envelope's red column carries [{path, rule}] (nucleus.md sec 2)

kind.$comment: secret class, e.g. api-key (pattern set: exact-match substrate secret values, Bearer/sk-/AKIA/JWT/query-credential shapes -- B.5 steps 1-2)

redactions.$comment: the reserved wire envelope column the markers land in (B.5 step 3; wire.md 2.1)

privileged_types.$comment: B.9 -- the firewall's ALWAYS-privileged set (conductor-only mint, Stage-1b-signed on trigger); plus round_open conditionally privileged (self-clocked only where the run manifest declares it, and then never gen-bump-bearing, R14) and act_receipt mint-restricted to EXECUTOR principals (never the acting cell -- A5: no act reports itself); oracle_gap is NEVER privileged (R14). The wire sec 3 table is the ONE privilege source of truth; the Stage-1b signature-requirement column IS its ACL column. The honest registry count is 17 -- arithmetic follows the ACL, not the reverse

export_bundle.$comment: B.7 -- hc export <scope> --sign: a signed, tamper-evident, identity-tagged, time-ordered event record (Article-12-grade shape; applicability NOT claimed, E.16). verify() needs no secret: redaction precedes canonicalization, so an auditor re-verifies the Merkle root and every chain link over redacted bytes with only the public key. SEC-EXPORT: a bundle with redaction_manifest.secret_count > 0 refuses to export; one flipped byte fails verify at the exact leaf

merkle_root.$comment: RFC-6962 root over the per-cell hash chains in scope (03's spans law)

pre_adoption_baselines.$comment: R13/s6-12 (MUST): the operator-signed Merkle baseline over each unhashed pre-adoption region, verbatim from that chain's synthetic genesis (nucleus.md sec 14); verify re-derives the region root from exported bytes and fails on mismatch -- the R13 legacy trust-tag read is admissible ONLY against a verifying baseline
